messages:
maya: Hey team — customer (acme) sees a big token delta between our SDK estimator and the invoice. SDK reports ~1.8k tokens, invoice shows ~3.9k. Theyused streaming and function/tool calls. Any quick ideas?

ryan: Do we have the request_id and a repro payload? often hidden system/tool tokens are added server-side.

maya: request_id: req_20260317_acme_43. Repro curl below — streaming, a system prompt, and a tool call. They used our Python sdk but I reproduced via curl.

maya: ```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-repro" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-32k","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the attached logs."}],"stream":true,"tools":["log_search"],"tool_calls":[{"tool":"log_search","input":"error rate"}]}'
```

alex: Thanks. Can you paste the SDK estimator output the customer saw (raw numbers) and the invoice line?

maya: Customer SDK estimate (local): prompt 420 tokens, completion 1,380 tokens, total 1,800 tokens. Invoice snapshot: 3,912 tokens. They also see repeated small increments in dashboard during streaming (metering spike every 200-300ms).

support-lead: Two hypotheses: 1) streaming stop boundary double-count (histor issue when stream close triggers finalization tokens + a trailing system/tool delta), 2) function/tool outputs include hidden KV metadata that SDK tokenizer doesn't see (e.g., tool provenance headers).

billing-bot: Note: invoice lines for req_20260317_acme_43 show breakdown: pre-tokenization overhead 0, system+tool hidden 1,512, prompt+completion 1,800, total 3,312 (discrepancy with public invoice due to billing aggregation).

ryan: maya - can you repro with metering debug header? add: `X-Redwood-Metering-Debug: true` and show the meter events. That header returns per-chunk token at server side.

maya: Ran repro with debug header — paste of the trimmed server metering stream: ```
{
  "chunk": 1, "server_tokens": 210, "note":"initial system injection"
}
{
  "chunk": 5, "server_tokens": 920, "note":"streaming increments + intermediate tool metadata"
}
{
  "chunk": 7, "server_tokens": 1,792, "note":"finalization + tool output KV pairs counted"
}```

sara: That 1,792 finalization number looks like it includes repeated sentinel tokens and serialized tool KV pairs. SDKs commonly undercount those because the SDK token-estimator runs on the client-visible content, not on server-wrapped metadata.

alex: Do we have a quick script to show difference? try the public tokenizer on the full server-visible payload (system + tool metadata). For customers we should provide a sample CLI command.

maya: I ran a local tokenization of the raw server-visible payload (includes tool json wrapper):

```
# pseudo: tokenizer counts on server-visible blob
server_blob = '{"role":"tool","name":"log_search","content":{"results":["..."],"_meta":{"sha":"...","node":"sidecar-12"}}}'
# tokenizer.tokenize(server_blob) -> 812 tokens for tool wrapper + tool output
```

support-lead: Action items: 1) Confirm if streaming stop double-finalize bug is active for this model/runtime (eng-runtime). 2) Provide customer an explanation and a short-term bill credit if counts > 2x their estimator. 3) Docs: add note about server-injected tool/system metadata and how SDK estimators differ.

infra-bot: Logged issue INF-2026-73: streaming-finalize-double-count. Affects models: gpt-xl-*, runtime: rtd-v2. Repro attached.

ryan: For rootcause we need the full raw server log for req_20260317_acme_43 (metering events + stream closure events). maya can you attach?

maya: Uploaded logs to acme support folder. Customer copied and confirmed they used default SDK estimator (tokenizer shipped in sdk v1.2.0). They tried v1.3.2 (beta) which accounts for tool wrappers and saw estimates ~2,200 tokens (closer).

support-lead: OK. I'll coordinate credit and docs. For engineering: prioritize INF-2026-73, also add a metering API flag to surface server-tokenized counts back to clients in real-time (longer-term).

billing-bot: Customer credit proposal queued: provisional credit of 40% on delta until fix verified.

maya: Thanks. I'll update the customer with repro steps, the provisional credit, and ask them to try sdk v1.3.2 beta and confirm. :thumbsup:
